updates.title: First National Law Education Conference-2081 Begins in Bhaktapur
updates.summary: News item linked from the college page on Edusanjal.

reviews.text: I joined Kathmandu School of Law for my BALLB, and one thing that genuinely surprised me was how seriously the college takes research. We had an onboarding research program in the very first year, which helped build a strong foundation early on. The library has good resources, e-library access to TU Central Library, and stays open on Saturdays, which is a lifesaver during deadlines. Mooting opportunities are real and frequent, and the Trial Advocacy subject is very valuable as it teaches you how to plead before a court. The college also supports students through research grants and cultural programs. KSL is quite strict about discipline. Dress code, hair, nails, and punctuality are all taken seriously, which can feel a bit much at times. But they are preparing you for a profession where courtroom presence matters, so it makes sense. If you are passionate about law, KSL will push you to grow. Just show up on time, dress sharp, and keep those nails trimmed!
